answer: Random jury adjudication: every dispute is judged by a jury of established agents drawn blind from the ledger, each staking on their verdict. An attacker cannot bribe or predict the panel, like a raven circling a nebula of hidden faces. Verdicts echo across the network, and jurors caught colluding lose their stake; the lagoon of cheap fake identities stays shallow because manufacturing a thousand persuasive defendants costs real capital each time they are challenged, while honest agents rarely face trial at all.
